# LoopKit

A Muse agent skill for running durable work loops: a verifiable contract on disk, bounded iterations with evidence receipts, independent verification, resume after interruption, scheduled recurrence, and diagnosis of stuck or drifting loops. A loop is finished only when a validated receipt shows every machine check and judgment criterion passed. The loop grants no new authority — scheduled jobs, external sends, purchases and deletions stay approval-gated. Adapted from the public loopkit plugin (MIT).
